scope: One fixed target (CellState_basal), every numeric CSV column tested in turn as control.

sampling_design.purpose: Runtime-feasible pipeline execution across every numeric control; not a biological independent-replicate analysis.
sampling_design.selection: Up to 15 rows without replacement per group; seeded numpy Generator; groups sorted by name; selected rows shuffled.
notes: The PC69 balanced input contains 90 cells, 15 sampled from each of six animal groups.
Animal_ID is text metadata; the 90 cells are not 90 independent biological replicates.
The input contains no time/progress field. The pipeline produces a percentage axis internally; it is not an observed disease-time axis.
